status: research input only; not wired into build_data.py
unit: EUR bn, current prices; USD converted at ECB annual averages as in trade_full.json; 2026 = January-August
what: The extra price Russia paid, above the no-war price, on goods it bought from each seller: the Russia-specific rise in the seller's own export unit values since 2021 (HS6, Russia vs the seller's other destinations), applied to the seller's direct non-fuel, non-gold sales to Russia. 'gross' is the extra price; 'seller_gain' is the part that is the seller's net gain (rent kept by residents); 'map_effect' subtracts what the map already counts by reading the premium as volume at the goods net-gain factor (vk.rx, or vk.rl for sanctioning sellers).

measure.data: UN Comtrade public preview API (no key), HS6 exports by reporter to Russia (643) and World (0), annual, 2021-2025; rest of world = World - Russia
measure.line: r = [UV(to Russia, t) / UV(to rest of world, t)] / [same ratio in 2021]; same quantity unit (else net weight); >= USD 0.1m to Russia in both years; HS 27 and 71 left out
measure.estimators: share_trim1.0 (value-weighted, lines with |ln r| > 1 dropped), share_trim0.7, share_cap1.1/0.7 (winsorised), share_wmedian (value-weighted median), share_umean (unweighted mean of ln r, literature-comparable)
measure.central: per group (CHPL / EU export-ban list / other): mean of trim1.0, weighted median and unweighted mean; low = lowest of trim1.0, wmedian, umean, cap0.7; high = highest of the first three; country-year total floored at 0
measure.groups: chpl = the 50 HS6 codes of the Common High Priority List (chpl.json codes); eu_ban = HS6 under an EU export-ban annex of Reg. 833/2014 (sanctions_share.json bans, luxury annex left out); other = the rest
measure.years_not_measured: scaled from the nearest measured year by China's measured time profile (profile); 2026 = 2025 share on Jan-Aug sales; sellers never measured take default shares (default_*)
measure.base: trade_full.json exports_to_RUS (own customs or mirror), minus re-exports to Russia (reexports.json scaled by refine.json; UAE 2025-26 as apply_reexports), minus Baltic/Finnish transit shares (baltic_transit), times the HS 27/71-free share of the seller's HS6 sales to Russia; Belarus: data.json from_rus (already net of its re-exports)

attribution: seller_gain = gross x a; a = rent share x resident share. Producers: 0.6 (0.35-0.8) x 0.9 (0.8-1.0). Hubs and front-company locations (KAZ KGZ ARM UZB GEO HKG ARE AZE TJK MNG SRB BLR): 0.45 (0.2-0.7) x 0.6 (0.4-0.8). Net gain on the rent = 1, genuinely extra = 1. Judgement, certainty D on the factor.
rule_for_pipeline: from_rus.years[y] (and years_lo/hi) -= gross premium G[c,y] for each seller (not the 2021 baseline): the premium is price, not volume
add an extra part 'premium' toward Russia = G[c,y] x a[c] (net gain 1, genuinely extra 1), low/central/high from seller_gain_eur_bn
re-exported goods, the residual and HS 27/71 are outside G; hub margins, payment-agent fees, CHPL marker and the windfall unchanged
certainty C where measured for a producer; D for hubs, Hong Kong, the UAE, Belarus and defaults

data_availability.comtrade_public_preview: https://comtradeapi.un.org/public/v1/preview/C/A/HS?reporterCode=..&period=..&partnerCode=643&flowCode=X&cmdCode=<comma list>  works without a key; max 500 rows per call (AG6 is truncated, so codes must be listed in batches); rate limit about 1 call/s (HTTP 429) and a call-volume quota (HTTP 403 'Out of call volume quota. Quota will be replenished in hh:mm:ss'; hit after a few hundred calls, about 25 minutes to refill). About 600 calls were used here.
data_availability.reference_lists: https://comtradeapi.un.org/files/v1/app/reference/H6.json (and H5.json, Reporters.json) work without a key
data_availability.no_data: Belarus (no exports by partner after 2021), UAE after 2022, Vietnam after 2023, Uzbekistan 2025, Kyrgyzstan and Georgia too few usable lines; Russia reports no imports by partner
data_availability.not_fetched: monthly data, 2026, and sellers outside the list in measured_reporters (quota); the full set needs a free Comtrade API key or bulk files

literature.ref: Emlinger & Lefebvre, Working Around Sanctions. What Cost to Russia?, CEPII Policy Brief 50, Feb 2025
literature.use: FOB unit values to Russia vs other destinations, same origin-product: non-sanctioning origins +0.21 log (strategic +0.37), sanctioning +0.05; CIF/FOB +3%; attributed mainly to margins

literature.ref: Emlinger & Lefebvre, The Price of Isolation, CEPII seminar 13 Nov 2025
literature.use: +17% unit value of imports from non-sanctioning countries; strategic >50%

literature.ref: Korhonen & Simola, From sanctions to price surges, BOFIT DP 8/2025
literature.use: HS 84 only: sanctioned vs non-sanctioned +40-55%; growing (ATT 0.21/0.30/0.71 in 2022/23/24); China 0.36-0.65 log, Türkiye 0.23-0.44

literature.ref: Chupilkin, Javorcik & Plekhanov, The Eurasian Roundabout, CEPR DP 20097 (2025)
literature.use: unit values up; CCA3->Russia sanctioned industrial/dual-use +50-90%; EU->Russia sanctioned non-luxury +6%

literature.ref: Egorov, Korovkin, Makarin & Nigmatulina, Trade Sanctions (June 2025)
literature.use: counter-evidence: sanctioned products' unit values did not differentially increase in Russian customs data (quality downgrades)
